head.i: Senatus cccc virorum forte ductorum annuum.

main_text.p: Atque hactenus dicta de ix-viris & Areopagitis omnia ad optimatum statum à legislatore directa fuêre. Nam ix-viros ex lege ejus, ut est demonstratum, non nisi deliberato liberisque suffragiis ex optimis & honestissimis civibus eligi oportuit: & ex hoc seminario non nisi δοκιμασθέντες[?] aut ἐξεταςθέντες[?] rursum probati in senatum Areopagi sunt admissi. Cætera verò, quæ deinceps dicentur, magis popularia fuêre. Nam alterum concilium, firmandæ moderandæque concioni abeodem Solone institutum, fuit Senatus virorum cccc amplissimi muneris & summæ dignitatis in civitate, ad quem negocia omnia ad rempublicam pertinentia referebantur[illegible, ~5 letters], ab eoque examinabantur, & decreto interposito vel terminabantur si momenti essent minoris, vel, si pondus haberent majus, populi judicio porrò subjiciebantur. Quod quàm latè pateret,[illegible, ~4 letters] Xenophon de republicâ hac disputans[illegible, ~3 letters] his verbis velut negotiorum præcipuorum fasciculum breviter constringens[illegible, ~3 letters] nos docet. Senatui, ait, deliberandum de bello, de pecuniâ parandâ copiâ, de legum latione, de iis quæ quotidie in rebus urba-
[The right-margin notes are too cut off and faint to read; the marks above are placeholders for them.]

page.notes: The Greek words in the first paragraph are only partly legible at the edge of the scan; the endings are doubtful. The marginal notes at the right edge are cut off, so only their positions are recorded. The last line of text is a half word, "urba-", and its continuation is on the next page. The running head is set in small capitals. The heading is a title above a passage, so it is level 2.
